plugins.name: sg-sme
plugins.description: Singapore SME guardrails for Claude. Six skills: start from paper or photos when there is no accounting export, GST F5 close, the GST InvoiceNow (Peppol) mandate and its timeline, cash-flow with GST and CPF surfaced, customer replies that never commit the owner without approval, and shift rostering with best-fit cover on an MC, checked against Employment Act Part IV. Plus free ACRA and OneMap lookups and the Xero connector.
